author: Mark Atwood
text:
Blocked on workspace epic JMAP-grs0 per the canonical-template rule and the kb note from .84 closure ("the next agent picking up .52 or .53 will plan as a multi-bead epic, not autonomous frontier work"). The chat-server-local fix cannot land before the mail-server (canonical) restructure does. This bead is now the chat-server-scope tracker that will close when JMAP-grs0's chat-server child (JMAP-grs0.2) lands.

The new epic embeds the recommended design choice — option (a) nested HashMap — drawn from this bead's own engineering basis. Not filing 'human' on the epic because the bead's recommendation paragraph satisfies the AGENTS.md 'Recommendation: option (a). Rationale: …' carve-out from the 'When NOT to file human' guidance (the agent authored a clear recommendation in the bead body; ratifying it is not 'should we do the obvious thing').
